Name: A more hardwoody fence
Author: Delt1463
Description:
[s][b][/b][/s][center][s][b]`````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````[/b][/s]
Have you ever wondered why a hardwood fence is not very similar in colour to the hardwood itself? If this has been bothering you, offending your eyes, causing you visual discomfort (or even pain) or if you just don't like this discrepancy or [insert any other reason here] then this mod is the solution for you! After all, it makes the hardwood fence texture more similar to the hardwood itself (as well as the fence item). I don't think there's much to say here, so that's it :)
P.S. maybe in future updates I'll change the texture of other hardwood items to look more like hardwood itself
[b][s]~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/s][/b]
[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Download the mod file
2. Unzip the file
3. Transfer it to the Mods folder in the Stardew Valley folders
4. Enjoy a more authentic fence texture!
[b][i]P.S. don't forget to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/i][/b]
[s]`````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````````[/s]
